 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Showbiz Showbiz 'PBB Collab 3.0': Lorelaine Sañosa cries after receiving birthday greeting from son 
 By GMA News Published November 21, 2026 10:59am 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Photo: PBB Lorelaine Sañosa became emotional after receiving a special birthday greeting from her four-year-old son, Aifen.
 On Friday’s episode of “Pinoy Big Brother: Collab Edition 3.0,” Kuya surprised Lorelaine with a video message from her child, who sang “Happy Birthday” and said that he missed his mother.
 “I miss my baby so much. Because, Kuya, whatever energy I have, he has twice as much. That's why he's so bubbly. He's so handsome, Kuya. He takes after me, right? We look alike,” Lorelaine said.
 She revealed that her son is already four years old and is currently attending school.

 'PBB Collab 3.0': Shea Valerio 'hurt, confused' by Jeo Ong's actions
 Lorelaine also shared that she became a mother at 20 years old and started working just a month after giving birth. She said her family was going through financial difficulties at the time, especially after their restaurant business suffered losses.
 She further revealed that she has had no contact with her son's father since the child was three months old.
 As a single mother, Lorelaine said she hopes to become successful so she can provide a better life for her son and spare him from experiencing the hardships she went through.
 For her birthday, Lorelaine also received a special task, which challenged her to create her own choreography for the “Pinoy Ako” theme song.
 After successfully completing the task, Big Brother rewarded Lorelaine with a private birthday celebration at the PBB penthouse.
 She was given the chance to invite one female housemate and chose Bela Arcal, who joined her for a night of food, drinks, and heart-to-heart conversations.
 The two enjoyed roasted chicken and shared stories over drinks before other female housemates later joined the celebration, turning it into a fun girls' night.
 " PBB: Collab 3.0 " premiered on October 24 with 16 housemates. Two have already been evicted: Ethan Benares and Calix Esguerra.
 The series airs on GMA Network from Mondays to Fridays at 9:35 p.m., Saturdays at 6:15 p.m., and Sundays at 4:45 p.m. —Carby Rose Basina/JCB, GMA News
